items.question: What form, status, and structure characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal in status.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center with eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet.
Whether aṣṭa and patra are treated as a fused compound in the original text.
items.plain_english: The sixth cakra, indeed royal, has eight petals and a pericarp.
